Subject: Interviewer redistribution playbook — HiringCo urgent slate

Team — hiringco just pushed a 3-week slate (30 interviews) for their backend+infra roles starting next Mon. Their recruiter (Sam) flagged a few constraints:
- Many interviews clustered in the 11a-2p window PST
- Several hiring managers unavailable for the first week
- Need at least two senior/tech-leaders per day for loop calibration

Can we put together a short redistribution playbook (roles, fallback pool, swap rules) and a quick skill-tagged interviewer swap matrix? I started a template and attached a CSV of the current skill tags we have.

Ask:
1) Laura — can you scope a minimum standby pool and a rapid backfill cadence (30/60/90 minute response targets)?
2) Marissa — can you propose a candidate-facing debrief schedule (post-interview sync) that keeps HiringCo feedback within 24 hours?
3) Karthik — can you map which infra/backend folks can flex into the 11a-2p window and highlight any conflicts?

I attached the first draft (redistribution-playbook-v1.xlsx) — please add comments directly. Sam/Kavita: if there are hard blackout dates for the hiring managers, drop those in the Drive link.

Thanks — Jonas

--
Jonas Weber
Senior Recruiting Ops Partner
Redwood Inference

Thanks Jonas. Quick notes after a first pass on the X-sheet:
- Standby pool: recommend 6 folks (2 senior, 2 mid, 2 generalists) per heavy day; rotates in 3-day blocks to avoid burnout.
- Response targets: aim for 30m for optional swaps, 90m for confirmed backfills (we can hit 30m during daylight with on-call secondaries).
- Escalation: if the primary backup cannot commit within 90m, escalate to the overall on-call (Marissa) who has authority to assign cross-team deputies.

I'll populate the standby roster (names + skill tags) and drop comments in the sheet by EOD.
